demonstration.headline: full-corpus solve: 4.69 s cold vs 1.74 s warm client wall (0.37x); ~3 s per request of data-file load amortized

conditions: The warm path skips data-file reload only — the sha256 fingerprint of every referenced input file runs on every request, and a changed file is a miss that revalidates; no solver step or qualification is skipped.
The cache is single-slot: alternating between two corpora thrashes honestly (demonstrated in the G4 ledger); same-corpus sweeps/optimize/per-bin workloads are the intended shape.
Cancellation is by process termination — an in-flight solve is killed, reaped, and re-issued; the restart path was demonstrated byte-identical to a never-killed run.
